range-query.subject: A bronze ruler with two gold brackets clamped on it, a cluster of cyan crystals glowing between the brackets.

lower-bound-ward.subject: A bronze shield with one small amber crystal fitted exactly into a notch on its rim, a gold arrow pointing up to it.

write-ahead-log.subject: A rolled bronze scroll with small crystals slotted along its edge like beads, one large crystal waiting beside it.

cursor.subject: A bronze arrowhead cursor gliding along a shelf of crystals, the three it has passed glowing amber.

bloom-filter.subject: A bronze sieve with a few lit holes, crystals passing through, one cyan crystal slipping through a hole marked with a tiny question-mark-shaped glint.

consistent-hashing.subject: A bronze ring with three small foe-shaped markers on its rim and crystals sitting at points around it, short gold arcs pointing clockwise.

exponential-search.subject: A bronze frog mid-leap over a row of crystals, its jumps marked by gold arcs that double in length.

ternary-search.subject: A bronze mountain silhouette made of stacked crystals, a gold flag planted on the single tallest crystal at the peak.

counting-sort.subject: A bronze rack of pigeonholes, each holding a stack of identical crystals, the stacks of different heights.
